body: Round 1 (de3b73cc..b387d3f1), P2 high, row 4303212235: `uv tool uninstall hcom` ran under errexit, so an hcom uv no longer had (uninstalled by hand, or by an earlier run that then failed on an rm) made every rerun exit 2 before the binary, wheel and step were removed. Fixed in 5f1f3846: remove_hcom reads uv's tool dir and, when <dir>/hcom is absent, prints a SKIP line and still removes the recorded paths and the step; test test_hcom_removal_skips_the_uninstall_when_uv_has_no_hcom_and_removes_the_rest in 91653681, red at b387d3f1 (validation 3a).

Round 1, P2 medium, row local:fbbc6d9:1: the entry 'moved aside' lived in the run's temporary directory, which the EXIT trap deleted on success and on SIGTERM during npm install, and a directory at the omp path was moved and deleted against #405's contract. Fixed in 5f1f3846: the entry moves to ~/.local/share/agent-assets/omp/omp.previous (named in the output) and only a file or a link moves (a directory stays for npm); the updater test's kept-aside and directory cases in 91653681 are red at b387d3f1 (validation 8a).

Round 1, P3 medium, row local:fbbc6d9:1: the glob *lib/node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/* took a link into another prefix's copy of the package for npm's own, so npm then failed with EEXIST; the fixture copied the same loose check. Fixed in 5f1f3846: only ../lib/node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/* or ${HOME}/.local/lib/node_modules/@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent/* count (two plain patterns, no extglob, so macOS bash 3.2 parses them), and the fixture npm owns only this prefix's link; the foreign case in 91653681 is red at b387d3f1.

Round 1, P3 high: the uv check ran in every mode, so the default dry run without uv printed no plan. Fixed in 5f1f3846: only --yes requires uv (as remove_brew requires brew); test test_hcom_dry_run_without_uv_prints_the_plan in 91653681, red at b387d3f1 (validation 3a).
Round 1, P3 high: the replaced #405 test had asserted that a dangling link's former target is printed. Restored in 91653681 for the dangling, external and foreign links; the code prints it.

Round 2 (b387d3f1..5f1f3846), P1 high, row 4303212235: `uv tool dir` was read with colour on; under FORCE_COLOR or CLICOLOR_FORCE, which herdr-agents exports in every pane, uv 0.13.1 wraps the path in \e[36m..\e[39m, so the hcom check was always false and --yes removed the binary, wheel and step but left uv's tool environment and receipt. Fixed in 8ea9bf8a with `uv tool dir --color never` (the remedy #405 applied to uv tool list); the stub in c47f5c7a colours its output unless it gets --color never, and the environment and receipt tests are red at 5f1f3846 (validation 3b); real uv checked in validation 3c.

Round 2, P3 high: the previous omp.previous is removed before the install, so a failed install restores the new entry and the earlier kept copy is gone. Declared residual in report.md: one generation is the design (the kept path holds the entry the last install replaced).

Round 2, P3 medium: ~/.local/share/agent-assets/omp/omp.previous has no manifest record, so remove-agent-asset update_omp never removes it. Declared residual in report.md: remove-agent-asset update_omp already refuses the recorded ~/.local/bin/omp (outside the safe roots, before and after this PR), so the omp step has no working reverse path either way; outside the owned rows.

Round 3 (c47f5c7a..8ea9bf8a), same reviewer with its context kept: Verdict: correct, no new finding. The round-2 P1 is closed: with the real uv 0.13.1 under FORCE_COLOR=1 CLICOLOR_FORCE=1 and UV_TOOL_DIR holding hcom/, the dry run plans 'uv tool uninstall hcom' with no escape bytes (it printed the SKIP line before 8ea9bf8a); c47f5c7a's two tests fail against 5f1f3846's remover and the module passes 21 tests at 8ea9bf8a; shellcheck -x, shfmt and /bin/bash 3.2 -n are clean. It agrees with both round-2 P3 residuals and asked that the kept omp.previous be named in report.md, which its Residuals section does.
